comments.author: Marco Reyes
comments.body: Easy validation fix; want product to confirm null vs omit for unassign before we ship.

content.text: Easy validation fix; want product to confirm null vs omit for unassign before we ship.

PUT /v2/issues/{id} accepts assignee_slot: "" and stores an empty string instead of rejecting the body. Downstream assignment UIs treat empty string as a distinct slot from null, showing a blank chip that cannot be cleared without a raw API call.

Validation already rejects whitespace-only display names and unknown slot tokens, but the empty string bypasses the enum check because the binder coerces "" to a present optional before the non-empty rule runs.
Expected: 400 with code field_invalid and message that assignee_slot must be a non-empty slot id or omitted/null to unassign. Actual: 200 with assignee_slot saved as "".
